🌟 Community Spotlight! Yesterday, we had the privilege of joining an Advisory Workshop with Codetalk St. Joseph Center in Venice. For those unfamiliar, CodeTalk is a web technology vocational program supporting low-income, underemployed, and underserved women.

CodeTalk equips participants with the technical and professional skills needed to launch meaningful careers in tech.

Our session included:
 ✨ Career journey sharing & professional development tips
 💬 Open Q&A on job searching, resilience, and navigating opportunities
 💼 Resume feedback & workplace readiness guidance

This is just one way we are committed to empowering the next generation of women in tech through mentorship, support, and real-world insights

Huge thanks to our members April (Cadiente) Schneider, Kavita Anand, Miriam (Holzman) Sharman, Nadya Ichinomiya, and Talia Standring, and a special shoutout to Sharon Plunkett and the incredible team at CodeTalk for hosting such a meaningful and collaborative event.💻✨

2025 Tech Predictions: The Year of AI Maturity and Cybersecurity Evolution.

☁️ Cloud & Infrastructure: Multi-cloud strategies, edge computing, and sustainable data centers will dominate as businesses prioritize cost efficiency, resilience, and environmental responsibility.

🌍 Broader Impacts: Blockchain will drive supply chain transparency, while shifts in tech talent and geopolitical policies will shape the workforce and global investment trends.
